content: Complementing this core infrastructure, the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa reported that the fixed broadband market experienced rapid growth throughout 2025 and early 2026, reflecting accelerated momentum in internet accessibility and service provisioning [135] . While historical data indicates that 82.1% of South Africans were already connected to the internet as early as 2021, the market has since evolved dramatically, necessitating more advanced and integrated service models [132] . Global service providers have also significantly influenced local market dynamics. For instance, by the first quarter of 2026, Starlink had amassed an estimated half a million subscribers across the African continent, establishing its infrastructure as a competitive benchmark for internet performance and speed [134] . Although connectivity performance can vary significantly across geographic areas—as evidenced by declining regional speeds in East Africa between 2024 and 2026—the overarching trend in South Africa points toward growing infrastructure capacity and increasing user adoption [134] . These foundational shifts create a highly fertile ground for innovative, converged connectivity services. Within this rapidly expanding and increasingly competitive market, Vcom has identified critical technology convergence opportunities through the deployment of bundled solutions. To maintain a competitive edge and address the increasing complexity of enterprise demands, Vcom is actively pursuing technology convergence opportunities, most notably through the strategic integration of its IT and network infrastructure with Veramani solutions. Platforms like the ADSC 2026 Tech Expo have played a vital role in fostering collaboration by providing critical networking opportunities and showcasing emerging innovations that demand highly integrated network architectures [145] . Ultimately, the technology convergence opportunity realized through the integration of Vcom's infrastructure with Veramani solutions fundamentally alters the company's operational capabilities in South Africa. By prioritizing streamlined operations and securing baseline operational efficiencies, Vcom is systematically dismantling the historical barriers between its IT and network engineering domains.
